summary: Frontend smoke testing of Elise Learns SPA. Home page renders all 6 activity cards with correct data-testids. CRITICAL: ABC flashcard renders as blank white area - the wood-card-* color palette CSS classes (wood-card-sage/mustard/coral/blue/pink) do not appear to apply background colors, leaving white-on-white text invisible on the Alphabet flashcard. Same risk affects Numbers (wood-card-mustard hero), Rhymes selected pick (wood-card-sage), and apple highlight (wood-card-coral). All routes are reachable. Navigation buttons and progress indicator render fine. TTS speech monkey-patch test errored due to test-script issue (not app bug); speech.js implementation looks correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Flashcard appears as blank white area at /abc - the giant letter 'A' and word 'Apple' are styled with color:#fff but the wood-card-sage / wood-card-mustard / wood-card-coral / wood-card-blue / wood-card-pink CSS classes appear to NOT apply a colored background. Result: white text on white background, content invisible. Verify these classes are defined in index.css/App.css.

ui_bugs.component: Numbers.jsx hero, Rhymes selected pick, Numbers tapped apple
ui_bugs.issue: Same wood-card-* palette classes are used to indicate state (mustard hero, sage selected rhyme, coral tapped apple). If background colors are missing, these affordances will all be invisible/indistinguishable. Needs visual verification on each page.

issues: Flashcard area is empty white - confirmed via screenshot. Letter and word are not visible due to missing background color from wood-card-sage class.

action_items: Define wood-card-sage / wood-card-mustard / wood-card-coral / wood-card-blue / wood-card-pink CSS classes with their proper pastel background colors in index.css or App.css. Verify by reloading /abc and seeing the green 'A Apple' card.
After CSS fix, re-verify Numbers hero card (mustard), tapped apples (coral), and selected rhyme pick (sage) are visually distinct.
Confirm wood-press / wood-card / animate-rise / animate-pop / animate-wiggle / animate-rise / animate-float / elise-bg / font-display utilities are also defined.
critical_code_review_comments: speech.js: setting onvoiceschanged overwrites any prior handler - acceptable here.
Numbers.jsx: setN inside button updates n which triggers useEffect resetting counted and speaking; OK.
Shapes.jsx options memo recomputes on round - fine.
ParentDashboard reset uses window.confirm which blocks E2E tests; consider a custom confirm modal.

success_rate.frontend: Home + routing verified; ABC visual rendering FAILED due to missing CSS palette classes; remaining pages not fully exercised due to test-script speech monkey-patch error

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run a full Playwright sweep AFTER main agent confirms wood-card-* palette CSS classes exist and apply background colors. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://tiny-learners-60.preview.emergentagent.com. Avoid monkey-patching window.speechSynthesis.speak via page.evaluate (the bound original throws when arrow wrapper passes utterance) - instead spy with a pre-init script: page.add_init_script("window.__sp=0; const o=window.speechSynthesis; const orig=o.speak.bind(o); o.speak=function(u){window.__sp++;return orig(u);}"). Test data-testids per request: activity-card-{alphabet,numbers,colors,shapes-puzzle,animals,rhymes}, alphabet-flashcard, current-letter, next/prev-letter-btn, alphabet-progress, current-number, number-btn-<n>, apple-<i>, color-<name>, shape-target, shape-option-<0-2>, animal-<name>, rhyme-pick-<i>, rhyme-title, play-rhyme-btn, stop-rhyme-btn, stat-total-taps, stat-activities-visited, stat-time-playing, breakdown-<id>, reset-progress-btn, back-to-home-btn, parent-gear-btn, page-title. All routes (/abc /123 /colors /shapes /animals /rhymes /parent) load. Home grid has all 6 cards.
rca of the issue: RCA for ABC blank flashcard: Alphabet.jsx applies className `wood-card-sage` to the flashcard with inline white text colors. Screenshot shows the entire flashcard area is blank white - meaning the .wood-card-sage class either is undefined in CSS or has no background-color rule. Reproduction: load https://tiny-learners-60.preview.emergentagent.com/abc on desktop; observe header 'ABC' and Back/Next/1/26 visible but the central card area between header and pagination is empty white. Mitigation: Add `.wood-card-sage{background:#9CBFA7}` and similar pastel mappings (mustard:#F2CA7E, coral:#E89D8A, blue:#A1BCE3, pink:#F0B8C6) to /app/frontend/src/index.css or App.css, plus border/shadow tokens used for the wooden look.
